attMtu.runtimeEvidenceHook: ACI_ATT_EXCHANGE_MTU_RESP_VSEVT_CODE logs Server_RX_MTU as 'Rx MTU size: %d' and emits GapEventTypeUpdateMTU with max_packet_size = Server_RX_MTU - 3.
attMtu.claim: Configured maximum only; negotiated MTU was not measured because hardware is absent.

dataLengthExtension.claim: DLE is enabled at stack init, but no negotiated MaxTxOctets/MaxRxOctets were measured and no product code explicitly calls hci_le_set_data_length.

phy.runtimeEvidenceHook: HCI_LE_PHY_UPDATE_COMPLETE_SUBEVT_CODE logs update success/failure and then hci_le_read_phy TX/RX values, but only when a PHY update event occurs.
phy.claim: 2M is preferred by default config only; actual TX/RX PHY was not measured because hardware is absent.

connectionInterval.runtimeEvidenceHook: Connection-complete and connection-update events record Conn_Interval/latency/supervision_timeout and log 'Connection parameters: Connection Interval: %d (%d ms)...'.
connectionInterval.claim: Requested range only; actual accepted interval was not measured because hardware is absent.

airbridgeSerialPayload.txBehavior: ble_svc_airbridge_serial_update_tx rejects data_len > 244 and fragments characteristic updates into chunks of <=243 bytes, with final fragment sent as GATT_CHAR_UPDATE_SEND_NOTIFICATION.
airbridgeSerialPayload.fapRelayBehavior: Pocket AirBridge relays WebHID frames <=64 bytes to BLE via bt_serial_tx; BLE RX accepts <=64 bytes and returns 64 bytes ready-to-receive to preserve HID-frame backpressure.
airbridgeSerialPayload.claim: Static maximums only; effective over-the-air packet size and browser write size were not measured because hardware is absent.

tuningDecision.rationale: Static inspection shows ATT MTU is already high, DLE is enabled, 2M PHY is preferred, and AirBridge requests a 7.5-45 ms connection interval. Without hardware runtime evidence for negotiated MTU, PHY, data length, interval, and throughput, changing BLE stack parameters would be speculative and violates the task constraints.
